items.name: lobehub
items.description: 🤯 LobeHub is your Chief Agent Operator, organizing your agents into 7×24 operations by hiring, scheduling, and reporting on your entire AI team.

items.name: taskuary
items.description: Your work, already underway. A personal AI assistant for your job: mail, chats and tickets become tasks, the agents you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) do the work, and nothing goes out until you approve. Open source, runs on your machine.

items.name: Octopus-SI-OS
items.description: A self-evolving agentic OS. A new architecture for agent execution, built on operating-system principles, with the harness as a path toward superintelligence.

items.name: CiteProof-AI-MCP
items.description: Open-source research assistant and MCP audit toolkit for systematic reviews: cited research reports, PRISMA tracking, evidence and claim checks, and reproducible exports with human oversight.

items.name: node9-proxy
items.description: Access control for AI agents. Set what Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor and any MCP server are allowed to do, review risky actions before they run, and keep every action on the record.

items.name: octomind
items.description: Open-source AI coding agent and agent runtime: one binary, any model, MCP-native. Runs in terminal, CI, or as a daemon.

items.name: pagesift
items.description: Rust web scraper & crawler for AI agents: URLs, PDFs and Office files → clean Markdown/JSON. Firecrawl- and Jina Reader-compatible API, MCP server, Python/Node SDKs. Self-hosted single binary.

items.name: octocode
items.description: Structural code intelligence for AI agents — semantic search, knowledge graphs, and a built-in MCP server in one Rust binary. Give Claude, Cursor, and any MCP client a deep understanding of your codebase.

items.description: A Utility CLI for AI Coding Agents
